entries.reason: Original twelve-viola score published by Bote & Bock; publisher confirms released BBC Symphony viola-section recording BIS-2016. Old 3–9-player exclusion no longer applies.

work.title: Testament for 12 Violas
work.notes: Original twelve-viola version; starts with rosinless bows, then rosined bows. Distinct from orchestral version.

sources.finding: Primary composer technical account of ORIGINAL twelve-viola version, 2002, 14 minutes, Bote & Bock; premiere 11 June 2003 Berlin. Public Online Score actual link https://www.boosey.com/cr/perusals/score?id=12286 requires login; stopped there. Generic repertoire note mentions winds and therefore includes orchestral-version material; not used for original scoring.

floor.finding: BIS-2016 recommended recording by BBC Symphony Orchestra viola section / Martyn Brabbins.

score.finding: Bote & Bock BB1100155 full score, 35 pages, available for sale; ISMN9790202530955.

researcherGrade.hardestPart: Viola I high exposed cantilena; twelve independent viola lines and bow/noise control
researcherGrade.basis: Composer’s original twelve-viola programme note explicitly describes rapid nearly silent rosinless-bow opening, a high first-viola cantilena, interrupted Op.59/1 slow-movement fragments, switch to fully rosined bows and fast aggressive/pliable development referencing the finale. Together with twelve soloistic voices documented by premiere review, this supports professional level 8 from exposed register, timbral control and ensemble coordination. Precise pitch range, rhythms and fingerings were not seen; estimate is not score-certified.

candidates.finding: Publisher recommended recording BIS-2016 explicitly credits viola section, confirming twelve-viola version.
